articles.title: Samsung units to buy $408 million stake in South Korea’s biggest crypto exchange
articles.snippet: Samsung Securities is set to take a 2% stake in Dunamu, worth over $200 million, from affiliates of technology conglomerate Kakao.

articles.title: Samsung units take $408M stake in Upbit operator Dunamu: Report
articles.snippet: Samsung Securities, SDS and Card will buy 4% of Dunamu as Korean firms prepare for tokenized securities and stablecoin frameworks.

articles.title: ElevenLabs, Stability AI Drop New AI Music Models—Can They Catch Suno?
articles.snippet: Music v2 brings genre-shifting and section-by-section composition to ElevenLabs. Stable Audio 3.0 ships open weights and six-minute tracks. Is either good enough to dethrone the category leader?
